To find the product of 17 and 23, we can use the standard multiplication algorithm or the distributive property.

**Method 1: Standard Multiplication**
$$
\begin{array}{r@{\quad}l}
  17 & \\
\times 23 & \\
\hline
  51 & (17 \times 3) \\
  34 & (17 \times 20) \\
\hline
 391 &
\end{array}
$$

**Method 2: Distributive Property**
$$
17 \times 23 = 17 \times (20 + 3) = (17 \times 20) + (17 \times 3)
$$
$$
17 \times 20 = 340
$$
$$
17 \times 3 = 51
$$
$$
340 + 51 = 391
$$

Both methods yield the same result.

<answer>391</answer>
